page.overview:
Who is Doctor Maple?

Doctor Maple was a surgeon at Haddonfield General Hospital. She was one of the attending staff members to treat Laurie Strode after she had been admitted following severe physical trauma at the hands of her psychotic brother, Michael Myers. She had gotten along with nurse Octavia Daniels and left the hospital before Michael attacked.
